about: The pinned looping playback test of the upstream engine that #507's Oracle page links to criterion 5, by its commit and the SHA-256 of its bytes. The lane finds it by that hash in the vendored folder for the commit (a folder under vendor/ whose name ends with -<short>), in $DEEP_ORACLES or ../deep-oracles/doneright/oracles; no name or path of it is written here.
